quotes.text: If you do sin: Elihu turns Job's question around: Job had asked what benefit he gets from being good, what harm from doing wrong. Elihu wants him to ask what benefit God gets from Job's good behavior or what harm from his bad behavior. God cannot be affected, only Job can; therefore, it behooves him to watch his step.
quotes.speaker: Raymond P. Scheindlin
quotes.attr: Raymond P. Scheindlin, The Book of Job, W. W. Norton & Company New York, 1998, pp 213
